Subject: Request: one-off rate split & packaging exception for Datashuttle

Team —

Quick ask: Datashuttle (Prospect -> strategic mid-market) is asking for a one-off structure that mixes a deeper first-year discount with a Dedicated + Private deployment commitment. Summary below; term sheet and forecast attached. I need VP/CFO signoff for an exception to standard pricing guardrails.

Deal snapshot:
- ARR (year 1 run-rate): ~$1.2M
- Requested commercial: 35% off list in Y1, then revert to standard ladder Y2+
- Proposed product mix: 2 x Dedicated pools (reserved) + Private control plane (VPC) + 12-month commitment
- Operational ask: Redwood to provide a one-time deployment assistance credit (~$50k in SRE hours) for on-prem integration

Why this matters:
- Significant logo in vertical (edge data ingestion) and channel partner introduces multi-account expansion potential (2–3x in 18 months).
- Customer requires predictable latency and data isolation — Private is a gating factor.

Request / ask:
1) Approval to offer an exception: 22% blended Y1 discount + $50k onboarding credit (instead of 35%).
2) Allow nonstandard packaging (Dedicated + Private) and a commitment clause requiring minimum throughput (to protect unit economics).
3) Legal to review amendment language; request confirmation on CFO signoff route.

Attachments: term_sheet_20261220.pdf (redline ready), usage_forecast_datashuttle.xlsx

If you want, I can prepare a 1-page memo with margin impact. We need a decision by EOD Tuesday to keep momentum.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
